as_told.title: Chris's family turns on him after the 2007 events

plain: Chris Bledsoe is a North Carolina man who says he has had strange encounters. Speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, he says that after what happened to him in 2007 he faced so much trouble from his community that he stopped speaking to half or even two-thirds of his own family, cousins included. He also says social services, the local agency that handles family welfare, came to his house and tried to have him removed from it, which shows how heavy a price he says he paid for speaking up.
